scope: Coverage and mutation control review; not specification closure

workspace.snapshot: Before the additional all-types GGUF metadata regression test; production sources unchanged afterward

coverage.limitations: Stable line/function coverage only; not branch, doctest or exhaustive-input coverage. Package-only percentages are not substituted for the canonical workspace gate.

full_crate.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --output target/model-weights-mutations
full_crate.observed_findings: Survivors include accounting, metadata import, chunk partitioning, preflight and container checks. The complete campaign fails the zero-survivor criterion; no equivalence exclusions or baseline changes have been applied.

focused_metadata_replay.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --re 'delete match arm D::(I8|U16|I16|U32|I32|U64|I64|F32|F64|Bool) in metadata_value' --output target/model-weights-mutations-metadata
focused_metadata_replay.limitation: This filtered later snapshot does not retroactively pass the complete campaign or cover its other survivors.
